findings.description: Everything ignored or skipped, exactly as the loaded plugin has it.

servers.description: The accepted servers, exactly as the loaded plugin has them.

skills.description: The accepted Skills, in directory order.

source.description: The commit-pinned GitHub URL or immutable Marketplace plugin/version URI.

oneOf.description: The normalized path in the plugin tree, without the leading `./`.

Cwd.description: Working directories hold normalized paths relative to their base.

Executable.description: The bare commands the runner image of ADR 0071 provides.

Finding.description: A part of a plugin that was ignored or skipped, reported next to the accepted ones.

Header.description: The name keeps the casing the plugin wrote.

denied.description: Paths the Agent Plugins specification forbids access to, left out of the copy.

reference.description: What the Agent definition records in `agent_plugins`.

McpServer.description: `sse` is never represented: a valid legacy entry is reported as an unsupported transport.

oneOf.description: The plugin loads; the offending part has no effect.
The component is left out; the rest of the plugin loads.

PluginName.description:
A plugin name: 1-64 characters of `a-z0-9.-`, starting and ending alphanumeric, with neither
`--` nor `..`.

oneOf.description: A Run-start listing of a remote server failed or was never made.
The Agent's allowlist names a tool the server did not list.
The tool's alias is one the Run's Bindings or the reserved names already use.
An earlier plugin tool of the Run has the tool's alias.
A Read-only declaration was made against a different input schema.

RemoteServer.description: Aidash's public-address rule (#376) is applied later, in the application layer.

Bank.description: Issued by the Home authority for a participant, independently of a definition version.

participant.description: `None` is the explicitly published Workspace bank.

cache_max_age_seconds.description: Home's pinned retention for disposable receiver quotations.

summarizer.description: Home-disclosed Summary Stage model pin, as for `RequiredHome`.

decider.description: Exact compaction Decider pin at the execution Node.

index_revision.description: Zero for native memory: index generations never identify canonical Unit reads.

summarizer.description:
